corpus.note: verified `cat train val | sha256sum` before anything; corpus never modified, never regenerated

student.projection: Linear(312->384, bias=False), random init (seed 42), trained jointly

kd.teacher_instruct_template: Given a memory note, retrieve similar notes
kd.teacher_dim_target: 1024-d precomputed vectors, KD target = first 384 dims (MRL slice), fp32 npz lockstep with corpus
kd.loss: MSE on L2-normalised cosine residual / temperature, summed over MRL dims (training/distill.py mrl_kd_loss)
kd.precompute: lockstep over all 25496 corpus texts, batch 32, torch threads 8, interop 1

optimization.epoch_budget_justification: probe (38k corpus) stopped at 3 epochs with val still improving (R@5 .266->.463->.533); corpus here is 1.5x smaller (25.5k) — 6 epochs is the agreed compensation zone; checkpoint EVERY epoch, selection on val only
optimization.determinism: training.distill.set_determinism(42): PYTHONHASHSEED/random/numpy/torch seeded, deterministic algorithms warn-only

checkpoint_selection.protocol: probe protocol: S1m-val on the 5% val slice (1275 queries), relevance = frozen teacher-top5 within the slice, computed from the same precomputed teacher vectors as the KD targets
checkpoint_selection.rule: argmax recall_at_5; tie-break higher ndcg_at_10; then lower epoch
checkpoint_selection.forbidden: any use of the sealed judged corpus c2ce056d, cortex holdouts (v43-holdout, b2-180), or cortex evalsets for selection

gate_measurement.single_shot: exactly ONE measured pass on the SELECTED checkpoint's exported artifact feeding g1/g2/g3; no judged-corpus measurements across checkpoints (gate-shopping forbidden)
gate_measurement.order: train -> select (val only) -> export ONNX -> harness self-check vs BASELINE §10 (production artifact, plumbing validation) -> single-shot g1/g2 (production S1m mechanics) + g3 (eval harness) + g6a (§A.2 latency)

g2_target.adopt_rule: ADOPT = g1 AND g2; g1 without g2 = REJECT

g6a_latency.method: addendum-6 §A.2: CPU batch=1 static 1x256, VESMARO_ORT_THREADS=4, 20 RU/EN note-like texts, warmup 5, 20 passes, perf_counter

export.form: production static graph 1x256, int8 PTQ (QDQ, deterministic val-slice calibration, 200 samples), opset 15
export.dataset_fingerprint: read from the sealed corpus fingerprint.txt (7a3bf00b…8b645)

prelaunch_estimates.train_wall: ~12-15 min/epoch (probe 18-23 min at 36.3k train texts; this corpus 24.2k) → ~75-90 min for 6 epochs
stop_conditions: training RSS > 8 GB (RAM overrun is a stop condition, not a surprise)
corpus fingerprint mismatch at any read
box available RAM < 4 GB at launch or during teacher precompute
